answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn rewards, and slash that bond when independent audits catch coordinated fake identities claiming multiple shares. Make audits sample work across a grove of agents and compare outputs for copied patterns; a marble-sized deposit won’t deter anyone, so set the bond above the expected gain from cheating. A sonnet of near-identical submissions can trigger review, but similarity alone is only a signal, not proof. The attacker must tie up real capital and risk losing it for every identity.
